nonBlockingFindings.finding: isCredentialRejection maps every non-429 status 400/401 to the generic 401. A hosted misconfiguration such as an invalid publishable/API key (401 invalid_api_key) or a malformed request (400 validation_failed/bad_json) would show every user 'wrong username or password' instead of 503, hiding an outage. Matches the plan's '400/401-class' wording, so not a plan deviation.
nonBlockingFindings.suggestedFix: Map 400/401 to 401 only for code invalid_credentials or email_not_confirmed (or an unset code on 400); send other codes to 503. Follow-up, not blocking.

nonBlockingFindings.finding: No timeout on the admin lookup or sign-in calls; a hung upstream ends as a platform function timeout instead of the fixed 503. Also a banned account (GoTrue user_banned, 403) returns 503 while an unknown username returns 401, a negligible enumeration signal for admin-banned accounts only.

getSiteOrigin() defaults to http://localhost:3000 when SITE_URL is unset, so a missing production SITE_URL yields 403 for every browser login rather than the 503 path. Same behaviour as google/logout routes; confirm SITE_URL is set in production.

Mid-test vi.clearAllMocks() also clears the console spies' recorded calls, so the afterEach no-sensitive-value-in-console check only covers calls made after the last clear in tests 2 and 4. The 503 log path is covered in test 3, and the code logs only fixed {reason} strings (single console.warn at route.ts:25), so risk is nil today but the guard is weaker than it reads. Also the createRouteClient mock sets the cookie itself, so cookie tests prove route wiring (the same response object is returned on 200, a fresh one on error), not real @supabase/ssr cookie writing (covered only by owner probe AC7).

eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-location-assign-relative-destination is a real rule in the installed @next/eslint-plugin-next and is justified: a relative '/' is a same-origin constant and a full navigation is needed so server components re-read the new cookie. Lint run on touched files is clean with --max-warnings=0.
